item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The federal budget dashboard reports €111.6 billion in payments to the pension insurance system in 2023 and a federal debt ratio of 62.3% of GDP in 2023.","notes":["The excerpt labels the pension figure as payments/services (Leistungen), not explicitly as transfers."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E005","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Federal Court of Audit reported that the citizen's benefit law was to enter into force on 1 January 2023 and was expected to increase expenditure by approximately €4.8 billion in 2023, including €4.2 billion for the federal government; it warned that the two-year asset and housing grace period, high exemption levels, and six-month suspension of sanctions could lead to abuse, deadweight effects, ineffective outcomes, and avoidable financial risks.","notes":["The excerpt does not specifically characterize these effects as labor-market risks, although it discusses the law's impact on the labour market and sanction effects on job placement."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0019-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
